EH Jobs Recruits Western Music Teacher for Primary Grades in Tellapur, Hyderabad

Overview of the Vacancy

EH Jobs has listed an employment opportunity for a Western Music Teacher focusing on primary grades (1 through 5) in Tellapur, Hyderabad, Telangana, India. The position requires the successful candidate to design and deliver lessons centered on Western music theory and vocal performance techniques while helping students develop pitch accuracy, singing abilities, and stage presence.

According to the official job listing, the selected educator will also be responsible for planning curriculum activities aligned with educational objectives, evaluating student progress, organizing rehearsals and school performances, and maintaining a secure and encouraging classroom environment.

Qualifications and Requirements

Applicants are expected to meet specific professional criteria outlined in the posting:

  • Experience: A minimum of 2 to 5 years of professional experience teaching Western music and vocal techniques.
  • Skills: Strong proficiency in Western music theory, notation, and diverse vocal styles, alongside the ability to instruct students of varying ages and skill levels effectively.
  • Soft Skills: Excellent communication skills and a demonstrated passion for music education.
  • Credentials: Valid credentials or certifications in music education or performance are noted as preferred rather than mandatory.

Practical Implications and Analysis

For educators specializing in performing arts in the Hyderabad region, this listing represents one of the active opportunities within the education administration programs sector. Candidates should evaluate their background against the requested 2 to 5 years of experience threshold and ensure familiarity with primary-level Western music pedagogy before applying.
